convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for CyclePeriod indicator and depends on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for position management, money management, and trade execution logic

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds for signal timing
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime passed to position open functions

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required before EA processes signals
derived_values.used_by: BarsCalculated check to ensure indicator has enough data

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum selects sizing method: LOT=fixed lots, FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss

custom_logic_notes: Entry signal requires two conditions: (1) trend direction from Value[1] vs Value[2] comparison identifies the dominant cycle phase, and (2) Value[0] vs Value[1] confirms the cycle is still rising (for long) or falling (for short) on the current signal bar. Signal is evaluated on bar[SignalBar] (default bar 1 = last closed bar). When SignalBar=0, the EA processes signals on every tick rather than only on new bars. The signal time is constructed from SERIES_LASTBAR_DATE plus the timeframe duration, passed to BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen functions from TradeAlgorithms.mqh for trade timing. Close signals are independent of open signals and controlled by separate input booleans (BuyPosClose, SellPosClose).
python_conversion_notes: The CyclePeriod indicator is custom and must be reimplemented or ported separately - its source code is needed to replicate the Alpha=0.07 Ehlers cycle period calculation. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library handles all position open/close logic including margin-based lot sizing across 5 modes; this must be reimplemented. SL/TP are passed as integer values (1000/2000) likely in points not pips - verify whether the library internally adjusts for 5-digit brokers. The new bar detection uses CIsNewBar class from TradeAlgorithms.mqh which must be replaced with standard Python bar-tracking. Signal logic uses CopyBuffer with offset SignalBar=1 meaning calculations are on the last completed bar, which maps cleanly to pandas iloc[-2] vs iloc[-1] for [0],[1],[2] indexing.
